stem: A child with recurrent paroxysmal abnormal episodes has a non-specific outpatient EEG, and further investigation is required; which next test set may be indicated?

options.text: Lactate, glucose, and urine metabolic screen

explanation: Lactate, glucose, and urine metabolic screen are the next investigations that may be indicated when the EEG is non-specific and the episodes remain unexplained.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Work-up of Paroxysmal Abnormal Episodes

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because a non-specific EEG does not rule out the need for further assessment.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because lactate, glucose, and urine metabolic screen are listed as further investigations when the EEG is non-specific.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because starting anti-epileptic treatment empirically is not the named next investigative step here.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because antipyretics do not address the need to investigate unexplained paroxysmal episodes after a non-specific EEG.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because a non-specific EEG does not justify discharge without follow-up when the clinical question remains unresolved.

sourceRefs: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
